# Species v2 compatibility fixture

`legacy_v2.json` was generated by the frozen pre-migration species v2 producer, from one synthetic fresh-lake column. It preserves that model's declared support contract, including then-current additive scores; it is not a physical energy certificate or a v3 healthy baseline. No test imports the old producer.

Producer source SHA-256: `5ea10310d5049efe86c9f42481161254e9eed73e9c47e5894c52204a6b697eb7`.

To reproduce with that exact producer version, load the fixture, discard its `species_range_records` and `summary` sections and remove every cell key prefixed `species_` plus `dominant_species_guild`; call `enrich_world_with_species_ranges(world)` and save sorted indented JSON. The function rebuilds all retained derived outputs.
